questions.question: Verify the historical name of the Moscow Pedagogical Institute in 1918 and the academy that established the seminar in 1959: the text names the USSR academy, while the biography also refers to the RSFSR academy. Check the exact honorary title.

localizations.source: Verify the historical name of the Moscow Pedagogical Institute in 1918 and the academy that established the seminar in 1959: the text names the USSR academy, while the biography also refers to the RSFSR academy. Check the exact honorary title.
localizations.ru: Уточнить исторические названия Московского педагогического института в 1918 году и академии, при которой создан семинар в 1959 году: в тексте указана АПН СССР, тогда как в биографии есть АПН РСФСР. Проверить точное название почётного звания.

questions.resolution: The Ushinsky Library of the Russian Academy of Education confirms the P. G. Shelaputin Higher Pedagogical Institute, the 1959 seminar and its exact title; the Academy’s history confirms the RSFSR academy’s reorganization as the USSR academy on 1 August 1966. The honour is corrected to Honoured Scientist of the Russian SFSR (1964).
